task_description: Three agents collaborate to gather information from various online databases, synthesize this data into a coherent understanding, and produce a comprehensive research report on a given scientific topic. The agents must ensure data integrity and resolve any conflicting information that arises.
expected_outcome: Each agent successfully collects and shares accurate information without data loss or corruption. Conflicting information is reconciled, and the final research report is well-attributed with clear, consistent findings.

agents.description: Responsible for querying online databases and extracting relevant information related to the research topic.
Analyzes the data collected, identifies any conflicting information, and attempts to resolve these discrepancies.
Synthesizes the analyzed data into a structured research report, ensuring correct source attribution.
